spec.description: Condition B for the between-subjects usability comparison. Same Prometheus datasource, same underlying metrics, and same $ap/$interval/$wan_capacity/$avg_daily_consumption_gb variables as Condition A (v11.2). All panels here query the raw underlying signal rather than the derived 0-2/0-3 verdict scales Condition A computes in PromQL; all colour-coded thresholds, value-mapped recommendation text, and thematic/priority row grouping have been removed; panels are laid out in a single flat grid ordered by original panel id. Built to isolate information prioritization and visual salience as the sole manipulated variable between conditions.

spec.title: AP status (raw)
spec.description: Raw reachability probe result from Prometheus (up{job="openwrt-ap1-node"}). 1 = scrape succeeded, 0 = scrape failed. No verdict applied.

spec.title: Station health table — AP1 (phy0-ap0), raw
spec.description: Per-station Wi-Fi health table showing only raw measured values. The derived 'Signal verdict' column and SNR colour-background banding used in Condition A have been removed.

spec.title: Top applications by data volume, 24h (raw)
spec.description: Same top-6-by-volume query as Condition A. Gradient colour-by-magnitude removed; all bars share one neutral colour.

spec.title: Total data consumption (raw)
spec.description: Raw 24h data volume consumed and its percentage of the configured daily baseline.

spec.title: Gateway bandwidth used (raw %, up/down)
spec.description: Raw upload/download utilization on the WAN interface as a percentage of configured link capacity.

spec.title: AP CPU & memory used (raw %)
spec.description: Raw CPU and memory utilization on AP1, as reported by node_exporter.

spec.title: Internet RTT — P90 (raw)
spec.description: Raw 90th-percentile round-trip time from the gateway active QoE probe. No verdict banding applied.

spec.title: DNS failure ratio (raw %)
spec.description: Raw share of DNS queries that failed to resolve, from the gateway active QoE probe. No verdict banding applied.

spec.title: Connected clients (raw count)
spec.description: Count of Wi-Fi stations currently reporting signal to AP1.

spec.title: Packet loss — WAN side (raw %)
spec.description: Raw packet loss ratio measured on the gateway's active QoE probe to the Internet.

spec.title: Jitter (raw)
spec.description: Raw inter-packet delay variation on the gateway active QoE probe.

spec.title: DHCP pool available (raw %)
spec.description: Raw share of the DHCP pool not currently leased.

spec.title: Link flaps, 15m (raw count)
spec.description: Raw count of carrier state changes on phy0-ap0 in the last 15 minutes.

spec.title: Packet loss — Wi-Fi side, local (raw %)
spec.description: Raw drop-to-attempted-packet ratio on AP1's station-facing radio (phy0-ap0), from node_exporter's netdev collector. In Condition A this is triangulated with WAN-side loss into a single verdict; here it is shown as its own unlabelled raw figure, unpaired with the WAN-side number in panel-200.

spec.title: WiFi channel utilization (raw %)
spec.description: Raw airtime utilization on phy0-ap0.

spec.title: Minimum station SNR (raw)
spec.description: Raw minimum signal-to-noise ratio across all currently connected stations on phy0-ap0. Lower values indicate a weaker link. No verdict or threshold banding applied.

spec.title: CWN Network Operations Dashboard — Condition B (Generic / Baseline)-2

spec.name: wan_capacity_mbps_up
spec.label: WAN Upload Capacity (Mbps)
spec.description: Known Internet uplink capacity in Mbps (upload direction). Set to your actual backhaul plan speed. Split from download capacity because this backhaul is asymmetric.

spec.name: wan_capacity_mbps_down
spec.label: WAN Download Capacity (Mbps)
spec.description: Known Internet downlink capacity in Mbps (download direction). Set to your actual backhaul plan speed. Split from upload capacity because this backhaul is asymmetric.

spec.name: avg_daily_consumption_gb
spec.label: Avg Daily Data Consumption (GB)
spec.description: Expected average daily data consumption in GB. Used as the baseline the Data Consumption panel's percentage verdict is measured against (green <50%, orange 50-75%, red >=75%).

spec.name: ap
spec.label: AP Node
spec.description: AP node selector. Add each new node's job suffix here as it comes online (e.g. ap2 for the second, mesh-connected node). Existing 'Network at a Glance' and 'Node-by-Node Health' panels remain AP1-specific until migrated to use $ap; the Mesh Backhaul row below already uses it.
